source: WHO/UNICEF, Caring for the Sick Child in the Community (iCCM), 2011 — treatment tables. Adopted in Nigeria's national iCCM guidelines.

artemether_lumefantrine.label: Artemether-lumefantrine (AL) 20/120 mg tablet
artemether_lumefantrine.how: twice a day for 3 days, with food or breast milk

ors.label: ORS solution
ors.how: after each loose stool, and as much as the child wants; give caregiver 2 packets

zinc.label: Zinc 20 mg tablet (dissolved in a little water or breast milk)

rectal_artesunate.label: Rectal artesunate 100 mg suppository (pre-referral, single dose)
rectal_artesunate.how: one time only, then refer urgently
